name: TranslatePlace
description:
Translates selected text through a configured API and optionally replaces the selection. Reads and writes the clipboard when a user-configured translation shortcut is used; sends selected text to the configured server and saves originals and translations in local history.

Requires a separately installed translation server, such as Translation API (Ollama): https://github.com/tomasmark79/translation-api
Default API address: http://127.0.0.1:5001
